counterfactual.change: Reduced bodies[1].vx from 27.7006 to 5.0 to remove high-speed momentum transfer to body 0. This single field change prevents body 0 reaching escape velocity, so in_arena no longer violated in 33 steps.

explanation: Body 1 starts at 27.7 m/s, bounces, then collides with static body 0 at step 27. Collision transfers ~30.64 m/s to body 0 (mass 1 vs 4.9). Body 0 then moves toward right arena boundary. Even with 18 substeps per step, its displacement is not caught by arena boundary collision/positional correction, so at step 33 x=19.449 + r=0.801 =20.251 >20.15 limit (overshoot 0.251). Counterfactual lowering incident velocity prevents high post-collision speed and eliminates violation.
vision_note: From steps 30 to 33 the red violating body moves steadily rightward away from the blue body toward the right edge of the arena. At step 33 the red body is visibly intersecting the right boundary, with its center+radius outside the allowed 20.15 limit.
